kind: Real external-framebuffer failure and source correction; not publication approval
diagnosis: Starting a chapter during the current controller frame rebuilt the scene, cleared headPose and reset the portal anchor. The same frame attempted to render the new scene before a new pose initialized the portal. The unchecked anchor.clone call terminated XR rendering.
correction: Retain the current valid head pose across an active-session scene bind. A reset/uninitialized portal also clears safely and returns without mutating or drawing world content until a valid pose configures its aperture. New unit coverage verifies the no-anchor case and state restoration.
scope: The test uses actual GPU base-layer attachments and artificial tracking. The failed old candidate is superseded for source correction, never counted as passing. All four modes and both layer paths remain required on the corrected checkout. Physical Quest retesting is separate.
